title: 2nd Annual Artisan International Value Stock Pitch Challenge
description: Value Investing Program students Amitaabh Sahai ’21, Eric Tse ’21, Joseph Li ’21, and Timothy Lechleider ’21 present their final projects from the Applied Value Investing class.
summary: The event is the second annual Artisan International Value Stock Pitch Challenge, sponsored by David Samra and organized by Columbia Business School to showcase the work of second-year value investing program students. The challenge provides students with three benefits: the process of research and communication, a resume builder opportunity, and the ability to exhibit skills live to potential employers, with the winner receiving prize money.
